_comment: Gate-side repository scanners that read tools/** without naming the files they read, so tools/scripts/wide_non_native.py cannot see them in a reference search. When the PULP_CLASSIFY_WIDE_NON_NATIVE repository variable is 1, the required `Enforce version & skill sync` context runs every entry with `python3 tools/ci/source_selftests.py run --manifest tools/ci/wide_non_native_checks.json`, so a tooling change the classifier moves off the macOS gate still meets each of them on a required check. Each argv mirrors the gate registration of the same script with the interpreter dropped and the source root written as {repo}; tools/scripts/test_wide_non_native.py fails when a registration drifts or a new tools-walking scanner appears.
